def _readout(channels, y):
    from sklearn.linear_model import lars_path
    import warnings
    z, soft, sat, cos_z, cos_mix = channels
    n = len(y)
    base = np.column_stack(channels)
    i, j = np.triu_indices(base.shape[1])

    scale_prior[base.shape[1]:core.shape[1]] = 3.
